latest_fy.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/EQIX.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
latest_fy.basis: Revenues for fiscal year ended 2025-12-31 as reported to SEC XBRL.

revenue_cagr_3y.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/EQIX.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
revenue_cagr_3y.basis: Three-year compound annual revenue growth computed as (9217000000 / 7263000000) ** (1/3) - 1 from the companyfacts Revenues series, fiscal year ended 2022-12-31 to fiscal year ended 2025-12-31.

operating_margin.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/EQIX.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
operating_margin.basis: OperatingIncomeLoss 1848000000 divided by Revenues 9217000000 for the fiscal year ended 2025-12-31, both from companyfacts.

operating_cash_flow_to_net_income.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/EQIX.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
operating_cash_flow_to_net_income.basis: Net cash provided by operating activities 3911000000 divided by net income 1350000000 for the fiscal year ended 2025-12-31, both from companyfacts.

net_debt_to_ebitda.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/EQIX.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
net_debt_to_ebitda.basis: Net debt 18894000000 (total debt 19873000000 as of 2026-06-30 less cash 979000000 as of 2026-06-30) divided by an EBITDA proxy 3898000000 (operating income 1848000000 plus depreciation 2050000000 for the fiscal year ended 2025-12-31).

piotroski.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/EQIX.json quality, computed in the Actions venue over SEC EDGAR companyfacts with financetoolkit.models
piotroski.basis: Piotroski F-score 5 (state MIDDLING) computed over SEC companyfacts statements in data/market/EQIX.json quality.piotroski.

beneish_state.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/EQIX.json quality, computed in the Actions venue over SEC EDGAR companyfacts with financetoolkit.models
beneish_state.basis: Beneish M-score -2.9, earnings-manipulation state CLEAN, computed over SEC companyfacts statements in data/market/EQIX.json quality.beneish. A more negative M-score is the non-manipulator reading.

market_cap.basis: Market capitalization 102588216660.00002 = SEC companyfacts diluted share count 98226000 (as of 2025-12-31) multiplied by the close 1044.41 of 2026-08-28 from the repo's own market plane (data/market/EQIX.json), not an issuer document.

price_to_sales.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/EQIX.json quality.derived.market_cap over SEC companyfacts revenue
price_to_sales.basis: Market capitalization 102588216660.00002 divided by fiscal year 2025-12-31 revenue 9217000000.

price_to_earnings.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/EQIX.json quality.derived.market_cap over SEC companyfacts net income
price_to_earnings.basis: Market capitalization 102588216660.00002 divided by fiscal year 2025-12-31 GAAP net income 1350000000.

ev_to_sales.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/EQIX.json quality.derived.enterprise_value over SEC companyfacts revenue
ev_to_sales.basis: Enterprise value 121482216660.00002 divided by fiscal year 2025-12-31 revenue 9217000000.

implied_fcf_cagr.basis: Free-cash-flow CAGR the current enterprise value 121482216660.00002 implies over a 5-year explicit period on base FCF 3896139000.0, solved by bisection on FCF CAGR at a 0.09 discount rate and 0.025 terminal growth. The discount rate and terminal growth are assumed, so the solve is an assumption-dependent expectation reading, not a reported figure.

horizon_spread.basis: Spread between the implied CAGR solved over the shortest and longest explicit periods in quality.reverse_dcf.implied_by_horizon ({'5': 0.1914, '7': 0.1471, '10': 0.1152}). It measures how much of the expectation reading is a horizon convention rather than a statement about price, and inherits the same assumed discount rate and terminal growth.

crowdedness_caveats: hyperscale-datacenters is chain-heat CROWDED; data-center REITs have been a well-covered retail and institutional theme since well before this chain's signal was written.

Leverage is the highest computed in this batch (net_debt_to_ebitda 4.85x), which is a structural feature of the REIT financing model rather than a company-specific red flag, but it is still the number the name carries.

confidence_audit.basis: Counts cover the canonical metric fields only. VERIFIED is a figure read directly off SEC companyfacts as reported. INFERRED is a figure computed from SEC companyfacts, with the derivation named in its basis. SPECULATIVE is reserved for the reverse-DCF solve, whose discount rate and terminal growth are assumed. NULL is a field looked for and not found or unusable without mixing reporting periods, never estimated.
